# Tetorica VSU Synth

Serve this directory over HTTPS or localhost and open index.html.
For itch.io, upload tetorica-vsu-synth-html.zip as the playable HTML project.
Play the Virtual Boy sound chip from Keyboard or Code, or import a VGM file to explore its voices.
The editable JavaScript and CSS ship with the browser app. The C++ audio core and build script are in tetorica-vsu-synth-source.zip.
